create.name: Tomek Wyczesany
create.bio:
Tomek Wyczesany is a meditation teacher and mentor living on the Sunshine Coast in Queensland, Australia. He spent more than ten years in research and teaching posts at universities in Europe and Australia and holds a master's degree and a doctorate, which he began in London and completed in Sydney. Alongside that academic path he has kept a meditation practice for over two decades, and his teaching draws on contemplative traditions as well as modern psychology.

His guided meditations on Insight Timer, where close to 100,000 people follow him, are plain-spoken and practical: breath-led morning practices, body scans, evening relaxations and reflections inspired by writers such as Thomas Merton. Longer talks from his Conscious Living Collective series, on presence, the inner critic, purpose and altered states of consciousness, are free on his YouTube channel, and his eight-day Insight Timer course maps out six areas of conscious living, from movement, food and rest to awareness, relationships and personal growth. He also works one to one online, mentoring people (often scientists and other analytical thinkers) on self-awareness, emotional skills, mindfulness and goal setting, and sells his guided meditations as downloads from his website.

courses.title: One-to-One Mentoring
courses.description: Online mentoring sessions that combine behavioural science, positive psychology and mindfulness practice with goal setting and accountability. Work covers self-awareness, emotional intelligence, a regular meditation habit and time management, and begins with a free 30-minute discovery call.
courses.price: $250 per session; $999 for five sessions (currency not stated)

courses.title: 6 Pillars of Conscious Living
courses.description: An eight-day Insight Timer course in which each lesson takes up one area of daily life (movement, nutrition, rest, awareness, relationships and personal growth) with a practice to go with it. The last session returns to a self-assessment made on day one.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Guided Meditation Downloads
courses.description: Tomek's guided meditations sold as individual audio downloads, including breath-based morning practices, body scans, a beginners' tutorial and reflections inspired by Thomas Merton. There is also a version of the Wheel of Awareness practice.

free_resources.title: Tomek Wyczesany on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page holds dozens of guided meditations, from short mindful pauses and morning breathing practices to longer evening relaxations, free to hear.

flags: Tier borderline: ~98k total, just under the 100k luminary line; Insight Timer alone is 96.4k and growing.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch (one sentence saved); bio check relies mainly on his own site pages.
Contact form is on his home page (Get in touch: name, email, message); there is no separate contact page.

His work leans towards evidence-based mindfulness and mentoring rather than an explicit spiritual lineage; meditation content and a 'Reconciling Ego and Soul' talk keep it in scope, but a human may want to look.
Prices on his site are shown with $ only; he is based in Australia, so they may be AUD rather than USD.

PhD details (started at Queen Mary University of London, finished in Australia, University of Sydney per Insight Timer) come from a podcast and his Insight Timer profile; the bio says only that he began it in London and finished in Sydney.
Only one photo used: the Insight Timer profile picture is the same image as the YouTube avatar.
